reasons.plausibility: Using a thin silver coating to reduce interface thermal resistance in W–Cu composites is scientifically plausible, though the stability of silver under high-temperature irradiation conditions poses some risk.
reasons.testability: Comparing silver-coated and uncoated composites under controlled thermal and irradiation tests is a well-defined, feasible approach that could decisively confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses the key challenge of enhancing thermal conductivity without sacrificing mechanical and irradiation performance, providing a concrete and targeted intervention to test.
